description: The autonomy.grant refusal for a merge grant whose expiry runs too far out (S56 T6, the -31833 family): a merge grant may not outlive the closed bound (90 days from now, from the vocabulary's limits) — an unbounded-in-practice merge authority is the same failure the expiry rule exists to stop, wearing a far-future date. The bound is the closed set's, not a judgment: the validator compares against the limit, and the sentence names the number.

data.what: a merge grant may not outlive 90 days from now
data.means: a grant is a human-authored authority record with closed rules (subject, conditions, expiry, the node it may sit on); a request outside them is refused, not silently corrected — nothing was written
data.todo: the refusal names the rule it broke and the thing it broke it on; `autonomy.vocabulary` lists the closed sets a request may name
